title: Dolphins Use Sonic Blasts To Hunt
description: Discover the incredible way dolphins hunt in complete darkness using focused sound waves. This biological sonar does more than just see, it physically disables prey.
instagram_caption: Dolphins have a hidden superpower that turns sound into a weapon. Follow The Wild Mechanics for more secrets of the deep.

segments.narration: In the pitch-black depths of the ocean, a dolphin's eyes are useless, yet it never misses a meal. How does it track and capture lightning-fast prey when it cannot see a thing?

segments.narration: But there is a secondary secret. Dolphins emit a focused, high-intensity bang of sound that acts like a physical hammer to stun and disorient their prey.

segments.narration: In a fraction of a second, that sonic pulse hits the fish, rendering them momentarily immobile and creating an effortless catch in the deep.
